idea-plugin.name: PHP CQRS Navigation
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate between Symfony Messenger messages and their handlers, and between EventDispatcher events and their listeners and subscribers.
  • Gutter icon on a command or event class, and on new Command(...): go to its handlers.
  • Gutter icon on a handler or listener method: go back to the message it handles.
  • The same targets are available from Navigate > Related Symbol.
